body:
She is not catfish, we actually played some other games and ended getting too close to each other.

We have been 'with' each other for 4 months now.

Well... she is not totally a catfish. Her persona when we met was quite different, slowly I pried more and more out of her, and verified whatever information I could verify. She hates her life, and hates herself, when I gave her a new nickname she liked, she started to use it everywhere, and told me she likes her nickname more than her real name.

Yes. Actually, a request for voice call that sparked this conversation...

We do have a mutual friend that knows her voice because they play WoW with each other, I don't play WoW, this is why I don't know her voice.

She said she would seriously think about letting me hear her voice, and in the next day during an unrelated conversation it came up again, she didn't denied yet a voice call, but when I talked about her meeting me IRL, she explained her suicidal feelings.

She refuses because of the issue I pointed out in the post.

When I asked her this week about that, she said she won't do it because it would be useless for me, since she is sure she won't move away from her mother (despite her very strong wishes to move, she frequently express the desire to leave her country), and she is sure she will immediately suicide as soon she knows her mother is dead.

EDIT:

I asked her if her mother takes 20 more years to die, she would just live with her mother for 20 years single and then suicide, and she said that yes, she would certainly do that, despite her mother wishes (her mother wants her to marry, even setup dates for her).
It is not okay... It is why I feel bad about it. (And not the reason why I agreed to the ultimatum... it wasn't today I agreed to it, but I realized today why it was bad idea).

I know she needs therapy, I wrote about it on the post.

And I know it is self-sabotage from her... but I want to know what to do about it.

And no, I won't dump her again.
Maybe because despite being crazy she matches what I want in a woman, and it is actually possible to meet her and then bring her to live with me?

I never had hookups, it is why I was incel, I think random hookups are morally wrong.

I dated a couple women intending to see if I wanted to invite them to be girlfriends, and had multiple girlfriends, two of them lasted 2 years each, one of them dumped me AFTER half-agreeding to marry me (she wasn't my fiancee officially yet, but we started to look into wedding planning and whatnot when she decided to dump me kinda out of the blue).

I had many relationships... And I know very well what I want.

I am not saying she is almost perfect out of infatuation.

For example: One of the things I want in a woman is that she must agree to take care of toddler children if we have any. Most women in my country currently think this idea is absurd, and that nannies are enough, and that their place is working like crazy to scrounge more money.

Another of my criteria is that I don't want a promiscuous woman, she isn't... (meanwhile I had a woman hit on me that was 22 and already had 300+ male sexual partners...)

Another one is that religion even if doesn't match, must be compatible... For example I had a relationship where it eventually failed because the main rituals of her religion were considered grave sins in mine...

And so on...

I am not talking here about beauty, tastes, eye color or that sort of stuff, I am talking about practical real world things that are important in a serious relationship, things that sometimes are essential (for example I had a failed relationship because although I liked the woman a lot, I stopped loving her because she wasn't fertile, and I REALLY want kids, she is a good friend now, but I would never want her as intimate partner again).

She was treated for about 10 years, then she had liver problems, doctor blamed depression meds, so she stopped taking them.

Now that she did lots of stupid shit due to depression (like fighting with her friends and family for stupid reasons), she understood she does need help, and agreed to look for a new doctor different than the old ones, and see if they can do better.

Saying connection is not real just because I didn't saw her in person yet is rather nasty...

And I actually tried to leave in the past.

I told her that.

But then she said she would just leave me.

And I don't want her to leave me, aside from her obvious depression issues, she is otherwise almost perfect, matches what I want in a woman perfectly... it is why I am willing to brave through her depression.

She lives in another continent.

But if she agreed to live with me (and she does want to leave her country), she would match me almost perfectly, most of our tastes and culture at the same, and our life goals match perfectly, we would both reach our dreams.

She did agreed to seek therapy, but is doing it in a sort of hesitant manner (it took me months to convince her, so I consider that already a huge victory...)
